steps.title: Gate a story for signed-in members
items: 1 · Create a page from the Story template
4 · Preview as a visitor and as a member

steps.caption: Click **New** › Page, name it and click **Create**
Switch to **Content** view to edit the page's tables
In **Metadata**, press Tab in the last cell and add **gated** = **true**
In the story section's **Section Metadata**, add **view** = **logged-in**
**logged-out** sections show only to visitors. Sections without **view** are public
As a visitor, the story is gone: **Keep reading** follows the cover
The **AUTH STATE** toggle previews the page as a signed-in member
